notes.title: Changelog for v0.1.2
notes.content:
First of all, a huge thank you to everyone who have been sending bug reports; hopefully this update should address most of the bugs found. A second update will be made at a later date for the undo and card placement issues.

For this time around, here is the list of changes for this update:

 Fixed mods only buyable once in the shop
 Slight memory optimization (bigger one in the works)
 Fixed inventory persisting between runs
 Fixed grammatical wording in boss tooltip
 Fixed crash if you clicked on a node on the first frame
 Fixed piles being squished too much when there are more than 15 cards (they are still squished a lot, but at least it's more manageable now. There will be another update on this to resolve that issue)
 Fixed bug where dealing and scrapping still made a sound even when the SFX were muted
 Fixed Rogue not updating the stock visuals on the same turn
 Fixed foundation piles being movable
 Fixed tutorial box reappearing on pressing Space
 Added game version to the bug report link
 Fixed redealing losing a fight when the win conditions are already fulfilled
 Added confirmation for losing fights
 Added options for bigger resolutions
 Added inventory UI to make the size limit more clear
 Made version number more visible


Again, thank you everyone for your support!
